mapper.sql: `id`,`task_id` AS taskId,`pro_id` AS proId,`pro_sub_type` AS proSubType, `pro_code` AS proCode,`topic_name` AS topicName,`company_name` AS companyName, `group_name` AS groupName,`expert_uid` AS expertUid,`expert_name` AS expertName, `grade`,`remark`,`confirmed_at` AS confirmedAt
mapper.insert: insert into ass_surver_expert_eliminate_confirmed (`task_id`,`pro_id`,`pro_sub_type`,`pro_code`,`topic_name`,`company_name`,`group_name`, `expert_uid`,`expert_name`,`grade`,`remark`,`confirmed_at`) select e.`task_id`,e.`pro_id`,e.`pro_sub_type`,e.`pro_code`,e.`topic_name`,e.`company_name`, e.`group_name`,e.`expert_uid`,e.`expert_name`,e.`grade`,e.`remark`,now() from ass_surver_expert_eliminate e where e.expert_uid = #{expertUid} and e.task_id = #{taskId} and e.deleted = 0
mapper.delete: delete from ass_surver_expert_eliminate_confirmed where expert_uid = #{expertUid} and task_id = #{taskId}
